top_signals.title: Trillion-Dollar Dislocation Hides in Calm Credit Markets
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Tosos Vossos joins Michael McKee on "Bloomberg Real Yield." As government bond yields across the world erupt, corporate credit has rarely looked calmer. Yet even in that market, about $1 trillion of bonds are telling a much different story.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Travel Industry Facing 'Self-Inflicted' Problems, Says Travel Association President
top_signals.summary: US Travel Association President Geoff Freeman said that the travel industry wants the government to work out 'self-inflicted' issues facing the travel industry as travelers face new visa policies and the prospect of more government shutdowns. Freeman also said that as travelers turn to AI, some of the industry remains 'inefficient' since most jobs travels companies can't 'turn over to AI.' (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Vance says Fed should lower interest rates: 'Would be nice to have some help'
top_signals.summary: Vice President J.D. Vance's remarks came less than two weeks before the Federal Open Market Committee is set to convene and decide whether to adjust rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
top_signals.summary: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.
